name: Thruster Charge
author: Henning Berge
description: Going Commando's Charge Boots charge on Clank's Thruster-Pack, running Going Commando's own copied code: with the Thruster-Pack on, double-tap R1 and hold to charge along his facing in the Thruster long jump's pose, steering with the stick, the Thruster-Pack's flames blue; enemies in the way are hit, a wall bonks him back. It replaces the Thruster-Pack's hover; its long jump and air boost stay. Needs OpenRAC with the rac1.player.update_movement, rac1.fx.world_quad.draw, rac1.fx.thruster_flame.draw and rac1.fx.burst.spawn hook points.

settings.name: Speed
settings.description: Times Going Commando's charge speeds (11.5 units a second, 30 in the first second).

settings.name: Pose: from frame
settings.description: The Thruster long jump animation's first frame the charge's pose moves between (it has 14 frames on PAL; the log says, once a level).

settings.name: Pose: to frame
settings.description: The last frame; the same as the first: that frame held still.

settings.name: Pose: motion
settings.description: How the pose moves between its frames: back and forth (no jump back), the game's loop, or held at the first.
